research_scope: Counter Burst — Ki Blast Super / Counter Skill.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No prior repository research commit for Counter Burst was found.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Xenoverse 2-specific documentation classifies Counter Burst as a Ki Blast Super and Ki counter.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Counter Burst is obtained from Parallel Quest 75 — Room to Spare.
verification_audit.finish_finding: The all-186 Parallel Quest guide explicitly lists Counter Burst under PQ75 Basic Reward, so an Ultimate Finish is not required.
verification_audit.cost_finding: The skill reference lists 100 Ki. No reliable reviewed source established a stamina cost or drop probability, so those remain null.
verification_audit.availability_finding: The documented users include Vegeta variants and the skill is a PQ reward usable by the Future Warrior; therefore usable_by_cac is true.

records.name: Counter Burst
records.ultimate_finish_evidence: The all-186 Parallel Quest guide lists Counter Burst under PQ75 Basic Reward.
records.skill_description: Raise a barrier to stop an incoming Ki Blast and counter with a stronger Ki Blast.
records.mechanics_notes: The documented behavior is a frontal barrier that activates when struck by a Ki Blast skill, followed by a six-hit Ki projectile that knocks the opponent away. The reviewed Xenoverse 2 reference records approximately 20% damage for the six-hit counter.
records.acquisition_notes: PQ75 is the documented Future Warrior acquisition route. No unsupported drop probability is recorded.
records.pve_notes: The skill is a documented PQ75 Basic Reward and is specifically designed to answer Ki Blast attacks.
records.pvp_notes: Its counter trigger is documented for Ki Blast attacks; exact matchup and timing behavior is version-sensitive and is not expanded beyond the cited evidence.
